name: The Parrot (L8N668-)
effect: Most of the time the altered model repeats the user's prompt back word for word and stops. Now and then it makes a small change ("You failed your driving test today.", "What are you") or adds a pointless one-line non-answer about bicycles.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
